overview.description: The Grayscale Solana Staking ETF (GSOL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sol, short usd currency. The fund is a passively managed fund that provides exposure to the price performance of spot SOL, the native token of the Solana blockchain network, with the potential for additional returns through staking rewards. The percentage of the staked SOL is disclosed on the fund website daily. GSOL was launched on Nov 18, 2021 and is issued by Grayscale.
